text: My linen is gone. There is a crate of bandages from the infirmary at the far end of the bunks. Fetch it, please.
Another wave. Keep your heads, and keep out of my wounded's way.
Hold still. Breathe. I have you.
Up. Up now. There is more to do.
I am not a soldier tonight. I am what is left of the infirmary. Mind the bunks. They are my patients.
Eleven came in with frostbite and three with worse. The ones who stopped breathing, I will not talk about.
Clean linen. Good. For two rounds, if one of you goes down near the bunks, I come.
Someone is down! Bring them here! Bring them close!
